name: Rustomjee Seasons
address: Madhusudan Kalelkar Road, near MIG Colony, Kala Nagar, Bandra East (marketed as BKC Annexe), Mumbai 400051
description: Gated community of six towers on about 3.8 acres in Kala Nagar, Bandra East, next to the Bandra Kurla Complex. Rustomjee (Keystone Realtors) built it as a MHADA-colony redevelopment and sells 3, 3.5 and 4 BHK homes with sun decks. Handover began in April 2020, and the last tower received its occupation certificate by March 2023.
notes: Redevelopment of a MHADA layout: Keystone's DRHP describes lender security as 'development rights of MHADA redevelopment Project Rustomjee Seasons'. It followed Rustomjee's nearby Oriana redevelopment. Launch date conflicts: the DRHP milestone list says 'Launched our redevelopment project Seasons in Bandra East' in 2013, while Rustomjee's press launch is dated 19 Nov 2015. The DRHP gives price appreciation from project start to OC as 2.13x (Rs 17,773 to Rs 37,934 per sq ft saleable), with a lifetime average of Rs 28,208. Cumulative sales were Rs 1,951 crore, with 72.39% of inventory sold as of 31 Dec 2021. Commencement certificate for Wings B, C, E and F: Sep 2016; handover of those wings began April 2020. In 2020 Keystone intervened in a Supreme Court property-tax case after MCGM refused the no-dues certificate needed for the Seasons OC. Free Press Journal (24 Mar 2023) reported the OC for the last tower and said the project was fully ready, but gave no OC date. Square Yards still showed Wing D (P51800021028) with a completion date of 30 Dec 2025, so Wing D's OC timing is unclear. Unit count and floors conflict: Square Yards lists 442 units; Free Press Journal says over 400 families; Mumbai Property Exchange cites 86 units for Wing A alone and gives 22 or 26 storeys. floors_max and total_units are therefore omitted. Architect credits conflict: Sanjay Puri in the 2015 launch release; design concepts by Alfaz Miller per the 2023 OC report; landscape by Site Concepts International per the DRHP. Awards: CNBC Best Residential Project Ultra-Luxury Segment (2018-19); ET Now Best Redevelopment Project (2019). Mumbai Property Exchange lists the BKC metro station 0.6 km away (straight line) and Metro Line 3 / Line 2B stations 2.1 km away. The labels are inconsistent, so nearest_metro is omitted.

news.title: Rustomjee launches yet another premium project in BKC
news.summary: Rustomjee announced the launch of Seasons at BKC Annexe, with 3, 3.5 and 4 BHK homes with sun decks, designed by Sanjay Puri.

news.title: Keystone intervenes in Supreme Court property-tax case to obtain Seasons OC (disclosed in DRHP)
news.summary: MCGM refused a no-dues certificate and P-Form approval needed for the Seasons occupation certificate, despite tax being paid under a Supreme Court interim order. Keystone filed an intervention application on 6 Mar 2020, and the matter was pending in 2022.

news.title: Keystone Realtors DRHP: Seasons prices rose 2.13x from launch to OC
news.summary: The IPO filing shows Seasons' average price rising from Rs 17,773 to Rs 37,934 per sq ft saleable, with Rs 1,951 crore of sales and 72% of inventory sold as of Dec 2021.

news.title: Keystone Realtors receives full occupancy certificate for Rustomjee Seasons
news.summary: The OC for the last tower made the six-tower, 3.8-acre BKC Annexe project fully ready, with over 400 families in residence.
